source.title: Generalizations of Helly's theorem; open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL for document 3766586. Direct retrieval of https://zbmath.org/3766586 returned a blocked_or_challenged Cloudflare challenge in the local fetch environment, so the resolver page was not usable as source text.

Recovered exact identity metadata from the zbMATH API: author Gerard Sierksma, Zbl identifier 0487.52007, year 1982, title 'Generalizations of Helly's theorem; open problems', and source 'Convexity and related combinatorial geometry, Proc. 2nd Conf., Oklahoma 1980, Lect. Notes Pure Appl. Math. 76, 173-192 (1982).' The API record contained no full-text links and was used only as resolver metadata, not as technical source evidence.

Ran a bounded exact-work recovery pass. Exact-title searches, Zbl/MR identifier searches, and host-volume or ISBN searches found citation/reference pages, library or bookstore catalog records, and later papers citing Sierksma's problem list, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing pages 173-192. Candidate pages were rejected because they were metadata-only, references-only, or different works.

No candidate questions were extracted because the only confirmed exact-work data was resolver metadata or third-party citation metadata, and the technical problem statements were not visible in a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-3766586.json and outputs/latest.json.
